cases.title: Deterministic JSON scoring
cases.whatHappened: Scored the same 18-word fixture twice with `node skills/ai-humanizer/scripts/score.js --json <file>` and diffed the outputs. The diff exited 0; both runs reported score 53 and wordCount 18.

cases.title: Unchanged text cannot claim improvement
cases.whatHappened: Ran `scripts/delta.sh` on byte-identical before/after fixtures. It reported before=53, after=53, delta=0 and exited 1, so a no-op did not pass as an improvement.

cases.title: Deletion collapse is rejected
cases.whatHappened: Ran the delta gate on an 18-word input and an 8-word rewrite. It exited 2 with `AFTER kept 8/18 words, under 50% floor`, preventing score laundering by deleting substance.

records.oneLiner: Deterministic AI-writing-tell scoring with a red-capable before/after retention gate.
records.residual: The metric is advisory and can be optimized against; a passing score is not proof of human authorship or prose quality.
records.standoutStrength: Stable machine output plus explicit no-op and retention failures make cosmetic score claims reproducibly challengeable.

cases.title: Conditionable generators route elsewhere
cases.whatHappened: A deterministic contract probe found the skill distinguishes memoryless generators from seeded, img2img, or feedback-capable tools and routes the latter to gauntlet-loop instead of wasteful independent sampling.

cases.title: Spend and failure paths are bounded
cases.whatHappened: The current signed candidate requires explicit operator spend approval or an already-enforced authorized budget, recommends 3-5 initial draws, and requires a spend/round abort gate with capability-ceiling escalation.

cases.title: Every candidate and tie-break remains auditable
cases.whatHappened: The procedure requires a criterion-tied keep/cut row for every candidate, a recorded tie-break for genuine ties, preserved cuts, and an explicit abort outcome. The contract text was recomputed with targeted `rg` probes.

records.oneLiner: Samples independent candidates only when conditioning is unavailable, then curates with a scored keep/cut ledger.
records.residual: No bundled validator enforces ledger completeness or an external provider's spend cap; those controls remain harness dependent.
records.standoutStrength: Separates operator spend authority from numeric caps and preserves rejected candidates as evidence.

cases.title: Readiness failure blocks the driver
cases.whatHappened: With fixture curl forced red and a repo-local marker driver, `smoke.sh` exited 3, never created the driver marker, and wrote a verdict containing VERDICT=3 and STAGE=readiness.

cases.title: Passing flow preserves checkpoint evidence
cases.whatHappened: With readiness green, a local fixture driver wrote `checkpoint=dashboard text=Welcome` and exited 0. The harness preserved VERDICT=0, STAGE=flow, the log, and the checkpoint artifact.

cases.title: Failing flow propagates red
cases.whatHappened: A local fixture driver wrote an observed-missing checkpoint and exited 7. The harness returned 7, recorded VERDICT=7, and preserved `checkpoint dashboard RED` instead of laundering a screenshot into success.

records.oneLiner: Runs a real-UI smoke path behind origin, driver, readiness, verdict, and evidence boundaries.
records.residual: Each browser driver must still prove it enforces SMOKE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and that its assertion can go red; the shell harness cannot infer that from a zero exit alone.
records.standoutStrength: Readiness and flow failures are durable coded verdicts, and an external driver cannot be substituted for the reviewed repo-local one.

cases.title: Independent findings do not become a fake graph
cases.whatHappened: A targeted contract probe confirmed that when no dependency edge exists, the skill stops and hands the set to ordinary impact sorting instead of fabricating a topological plan.

cases.title: Roots precede symptoms and invalidate downstream checks
cases.whatHappened: The method requires root-before-symptom ordering and a recompute note whenever fixing A changes B's evidence or target. Its done condition requires a true residual DAG and red-capable checks.

cases.title: Cycle mandate is not mislabeled enforcement
cases.whatHappened: After independent review found an overclaim, the cycle marker was changed to `required-bidirectional-recompute`; the text now says this is a mandate and becomes enforced only when a downstream validator demonstrably blocks missing cycle-member checks.

records.oneLiner: Turns interdependent findings into a root-before-symptom mandate with evidence invalidation and explicit cycle handling.
records.residual: There is no bundled graph parser or downstream execution validator; dependency and cycle judgments remain the composer's responsibility.
records.standoutStrength: Makes bidirectional evidence invalidation explicit without laundering a procedural mandate into mechanical enforcement.

cases.title: All five authority slots are present
cases.whatHappened: Targeted probes confirmed the method and output template both contain objective/definition of done, context, decision rights, stop conditions, and evidence.

cases.title: Irreversible actions receive tripwires
cases.whatHappened: Delete, deploy, spend, send, scope drift, unreachable completion, and budget/round limits are all named as stop conditions, with a scoped carve-out only when the irreversible action is itself authorized as the objective.

cases.title: Enforced and advisory limits stay distinct
cases.whatHappened: The skill requires an observed blocking probe before an enforced label and explicitly keeps budget/round caps advisory when the harness does not hard-stop the child agent.

records.oneLiner: Composes unattended-agent mandates from context, decision rights, stop conditions, and evidence.
records.residual: The document supplies no enforcement mechanism; live tripwire behavior depends on the receiving harness and was not claimed here.
records.standoutStrength: Pairs every grant of decision authority with explicit stop and evidence boundaries.

cases.title: Absent package in repository lockfiles
cases.whatHappened: The documented lockfile enumeration shape ran against an impossible sentinel and exited 0 with no matching paths. That proves only absence in discovered lockfiles, not a system-wide safety claim.

cases.title: Missing binary stays narrow evidence
cases.whatHappened: `command -v` for an impossible fixture binary exited 1 with no output. The skill correctly treats that as absence of the named check subject and forbids turning unrun checks into Not affected.

cases.title: Listener result records tool availability
cases.whatHappened: `lsof` was present; the exact TCP 65534 listener probe returned no matching line. The result is stated narrowly as no matching listener observed on that port, not a machine-wide exposure verdict.

records.oneLiner: Read-only named-advisory enumeration with evidence-bound verdict language and a constrained report destination.
records.residual: The workflow remains advisory; this lane did not generate a report, and broad-machine enumeration requires separately authorized scope and platform-specific checks.
records.standoutStrength: Its no-launder language prevents absence, unrun checks, and reachability from collapsing into one unsupported verdict.

cases.title: Vision input is a hard floor
cases.whatHappened: The contract states that image, PDF, chart, and frame inputs require vision-native capability and that a text-only model cannot clear the floor, then requires the demand, floor, choice, and rationale to be recorded.

cases.title: Cheap-bulk downshift requires a falsifiable probe
cases.whatHappened: The worked route supplies a labeled-set threshold, and the rule says no probe means no downshift; without evidence, the cheaper routing claim remains unverified.

cases.title: Model and price drift stay out of the skill
cases.whatHappened: Vendor catalog names and prices are excluded from the static skill and must be read from current environment data. The routing discipline is explicitly advisory rather than presented as a mechanical floor gate.

records.oneLiner: Routes by cognitive-demand floor, then chooses the cheapest current option that clears every hard gate.
records.residual: No bundled live-catalog or probe harness enforces the floor; the caller must supply current capability and price evidence.
records.standoutStrength: Clear hard-versus-soft floor distinction, with evidence required before any cost-saving downshift.

cases.title: Local-only artifact passes the static rung
cases.whatHappened: `scan-egress.sh` on a local-only HTML fixture exited 0 and reported 0 un-waived findings. This is static evidence only, not a lifecycle containment claim.

cases.title: Direct external script URL fails
cases.whatHappened: The scanner ran against a script tag pointing at an external CDN, exited 1, and reported one un-waived EGRESS finding. The direct reference could not pass silently.

cases.title: Runtime-built URL demonstrates the static limit
cases.whatHappened: The static scanner passed an HTML fixture that concatenated `ht` and `tps://...` at runtime. The skill now states this limitation honestly and requires sealed runtime observation; Playwright was absent, so that second rung remained unverified in this lane.

records.oneLiner: Pairs static egress discovery with a separately evidenced sealed-load runtime rung for self-contained artifacts.
records.residual: Static scanning has real obfuscation false negatives, while sealed-load coverage is bounded to the interactions and observation window actually exercised.
records.standoutStrength: A direct external request is red-capable, and the skill does not pretend that its regex alone proves lifecycle containment.

cases.title: Strict challenger beat produces SWAP
cases.whatHappened: Identical case IDs with incumbent mean 0.500000 and challenger mean 0.700000 produced exit 0 and SWAP through the bundled verdict script.

cases.title: Tie preserves the incumbent
cases.whatHappened: Identical case IDs with equal means of 0.500000 produced exit 0 and NO-SWAP with the explicit tie-or-loss explanation.

cases.title: Mismatched case IDs reject the duel
cases.whatHappened: Incumbent IDs c1,c2 and challenger IDs c1,c3 produced exit 3 and UNFAIR; the script refused to issue any seat verdict on unequal gauntlets.

records.oneLiner: Frozen head-to-head comparison with identical case IDs and strict-beat, tie-to-incumbent mechanics.
records.residual: Case quality, critic blindness, seat identity, exact-head binding, and whether scores truthfully represent execution remain outside the arithmetic script.
records.standoutStrength: The gate mechanically prevents narrative wins on ties, losses, or unequal case sets.

cases.title: Clean candidate emits zero scanner findings
cases.whatHappened: The scanner ran on model-routing and exited 0 with `0 candidate finding(s) across 2 file(s)` plus an explicit ADVISORY notice; the result was not presented as a safety certificate.

cases.title: Network and credential surfaces are flagged
cases.whatHappened: The scanner ran on research and produced five stable file:line findings across shell execution, network egress, and credential access. No network operation or live provenance was implied.

cases.title: Missing candidate path fails
cases.whatHappened: A nonexistent candidate directory produced exit 1 and the usage line; the scanner did not silently treat missing input as a clean skill.

records.oneLiner: Deterministic advisory scanning plus provenance and full-read requirements for inbound third-party skills.
records.residual: Regex scanning can miss obfuscation and intent; provenance pinning, pointer closure, and line-by-line human review remain separate required work.
records.standoutStrength: Stable file:line findings are useful evidence, while the tool explicitly refuses to masquerade as a safety gate.
